response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT e.ordersmark AS ordersmark, o.timespan AS timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.timespan), stats AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM per_order) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS diff_above_tif_avg, rnk AS rank_in_timespan FROM stats WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg AND rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark
